# netbox_power_panel (Resource)

A distribution panel powering feeds (dcim.powerpanel).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/powerpanel/):

> A power panel represents the origin point in NetBox for electrical power being disseminated by one or more power feeds. In a data center environment, one power panel often serves a group of racks, with an individual power feed extending to each rack, though this is not always the case. It is common to have two sets of panels and feeds arranged in parallel to provide redundant power to each rack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_location" "test" {
  name    = "test-location"
  site_id = netbox_site.test.id
}

resource "netbox_power_panel" "test" {
  name        = "test-power-panel"
  site_id     = netbox_site.test.id
  location_id = netbox_location.test.id
  description = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site.

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location within the site.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `power_feed_count` (Number) Number of power feeds fed from the panel.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_power_panel.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_power_panel.test 123
```
